toml:
# Launch-window & ascent geometry demonstrator (mission analysis, trade-study tier).
#
# Two-body spherical-Earth geometry: launch azimuth(s) from site latitude + target
# inclination (sin Az = cos i / cos lat), minimum reachable inclination, circular
# velocity, the Earth-rotation eastward bonus, dogleg plane-change Dv when the
# target inclination is below the site latitude, and daily launch opportunities.
#
# HONEST SCOPE: MODELLED. Geometric azimuth only -- no rotating-Earth
# velocity-triangle correction (the bonus is reported separately to fold in), no
# ascent trajectory / drag-loss / steering model. Pre-Phase-A geometry.
# Run:  kshana scenarios/launch-window.toml
kind = "launch-window"

site_lat_deg = 28.5             # Kennedy Space Center
target_inclination_deg = 51.6   # ISS inclination
altitude_km = 400.0
